**Agent Name:** Planner  
**Step Number:** 1  
**Reason for Mistake:** The Planner prematurely concluded that Lee Hazlewood was both the writer of "These Boots Are Made for Walkin'" and someone who died in 2007 without first verifying the accuracy of this assumption through initial searches. Although this inference turned out correct for one part (writer), the suggestion of Lee Hazlewood as "who died in 2007" was decided without explicitly confirming the details from credible sources. This oversight set the stage for repetitive WebSurfer queries in subsequent steps and delayed confirmation of his place of death. Rather than systematically confirming both components (writer and death details) as separate entities, the Planner fixated on validating the initial assumption, creating redundancy in later steps.
